summary: Iteration_3 features verified end-to-end. Backend: 39/39 tests pass (17 iter1 + 11 iter2 + 11 new iter3). POST /api/expenses/scan on a synthesized receipt JPEG (14.99 TOTAL, NOTION LABS, 2024-11-15) returned amount=14.99 (±0.5), a category in the fixed list (Software), and a receipt_path 'psybooks/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.jpg'. GET /api/files/{path}?token=... returns 200 image for owner, 401 without token, 403 for a different user's token. Expenses persist receipt_path (POST -> GET returns it). POST /api/invoices/{id}/email records emailed_at=today and auto-marks a draft as 'sent'; sent stays sent + records emailed_at; paid stays paid + records emailed_at. GET /api/summary?group=day returns YYYY-MM-DD buckets, and net == sales - expenses for the range. Frontend (web preview, mobile 390x844): registered/logged-in user; Dashboard period segmented control (Day/Week/Month/Year) updates the hero 'Net · {label}', the Money in/out/Invoices values, and the Cash flow card caption in lock-step (Today, This week, Aug 2026, Tax year 2026/27) — HMRC card stays pinned to 'This tax year · 2026/27'. Net for Day = £250 = £300 sales - £50 expenses on today's seed. Expenses add sheet shows 'Scan a receipt' section with Take photo + Gallery buttons (no JS error). Invoices detail sheet shows caption 'Issued 1 Aug 2026 · Emailed 28 Aug 2026 · No VAT (exempt)' after emailing. Settings screen shows 'Unlock with Face ID / fingerprint' row with biometric-toggle present (disabled on web/preview as expected — expo-local-authentication is a NO-OP outside a native device build). No deprecated Expo packages detected. Only console warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — cosmetic RN Web warning from a library, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py email_invoice: on send, records emailed_at unconditionally and only bumps draft->sent — correct: sent/paid statuses are preserved while still stamping emailed_at.
server.py scan_receipt: stores the image under 'psybooks/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.jpg' BEFORE calling the vision model, and returns 502 with a friendly message when Gemini extraction fails — good UX.

server.py get_file: verifies ownership via path prefix ('psybooks/uploads/{user_id}/...') and returns 401/403/404 correctly; supports both ?token= and Authorization Bearer headers, which is required because can't set headers on the web.

server.py summary(group=day|week|month): bucket keys are correct — day: YYYY-MM-DD, week: Monday-anchored YYYY-MM-DD, month: YYYY-MM. Net = sales - expenses is computed for the whole range (not per-bucket), which is what the hero card needs.
Frontend index.tsx: same 'range.label' feeds both hero and the Cash flow caption, so they cannot drift; HMRC card is intentionally decoupled and always shows 'This tax year · {fy.label}'.

Frontend expenses.tsx: 'Scan a receipt' section renders unconditionally in the add-sheet; 'Take photo' and 'Gallery' both have testIDs; a Rescan link is provided after a successful scan; receipt thumbnails use expo-image with getFileUrl() from /api/client.ts (which appends ?token=<jwt> — matches backend).

BiometricContext.tsx correctly stores an 'on|off' preference in secure storage and is safe to render on web (LocalAuthentication imports guarded); the Settings toggle is disabled when unsupported — acceptable web behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all 4 iter3 UI flows verified (period segmented control, expense scan section, invoice 'Emailed' caption, Settings biometric toggle)

seed_data_creation: Test users iter3_*@psybooks.com, web3_*@psybooks.com, invmail_*@psybooks.com. Clients TEST_ResendClient (delivered@resend.dev), TEST_SumClient, TEST_NoEmailClient. Invoices INV-000x mixed draft/sent/paid; one scanned expense TEST_ScannedNotion (£14.99, Software) with a real receipt_path pointing to Emergent Object Storage. No cleanup — MVP DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend needs to log in via the visible /login form (input[0]=email, input[1]=password, click a 'Sign in' element) because AsyncStorage on web is IndexedDB-backed, so pre-seeding localStorage.setItem('psybooks_token',…) does NOT work. To bypass @gorhom/bottom-sheet gesture handler on web, use page.evaluate to call element.click() on testID selectors. For receipt scan tests, build a real PIL-drawn JPEG with visible merchant/date/TOTAL text — solid-color or blank images fail image_testing.md rules and confuse the vision model. Period labels are dynamic ('Today'/'This week'/'Aug 2026'/'Tax year 2026/27') — DO NOT hard-code 'This month'/'This year'; instead assert hero_label === cashflow_label per period.
rca_of_issue: No product bug found. Initial frontend test had an incorrect expectation ('This month' / 'This year') — the app actually shows the concrete month ('Aug 2026') and fiscal-year label ('Tax year 2026/27'), which is the intended behaviour and matches the HMRC-year exclusion (HMRC card always says 'This tax year'). Test assertion was relaxed to require hero and cashflow labels to be equal per period.
